createAuraApp: Mount an app on a canvas or selector: `createAuraApp("#app", { scene, ... })`. The entry point for rendering.
model: Place a typed GLB asset: `model(assets.x, { targetHeight })`. Raw string URLs are rejected by the public-example boundary test.
group: Group child nodes under one transform.
primitives: Primitive meshes: box, sphere, plane, cylinder, capsule, torus, cone, circle, ring, tube and more.
material: Material builders: pbr, physical, metal, glass, rubber, emissive, clearcoat, neon, custom (GLSL) and node (TSL).
lights: Light builders: ambient, hemisphere, directional, point, spot, rect, studio rig, lightProbe, lensFlare.
camera: Camera builders: perspective, orbit, dolly, follow, shake, punchIn, gameRig, shoulder, followRig, collisionAwareOrbit.
cameras: Non-perspective camera types: cube, array, stereo.
environments: Lighting environments: neutral, studio, outdoor, room, space, underwater, hdri, preset, capture, none.
looks: Look presets (`looks.preset`, `list`, `describe`) for genre lighting and grade.
effects: Post effects: bloom, toon, ambient occlusion, color grade, vignette, film grain, anti-alias, contact shadows and more.
postPresets: Named post presets: space, underwater, product-studio, arena-fight, daylight-outdoor, neon-night, cinematic-film.
shadows: Shadow helpers: contact and blob shadows.
instances: GPU-instanced meshes by shape (box, sphere, cylinder, cone, ...) with per-instance transforms and colours.
batched: Batched mesh node (`batched.mesh`) for many geometries in one draw.
planScatterInstances: GPU-instanced scatter plan: density admits, distance culls, wind sways.
interactions: Input interactions: orbit (target is a node name), pointer, keyboard, hover, raycastHover, highlight, dragVector, clickImpulse.
ui: DOM overlay builders: text, button, html, range, scoreCounter, onClick, onInput.
labels: In-scene labels: billboard, anchor, axisTick, callout, hud.
text3D: 3D text node with an extruded-mesh or SDF backend.
helpers: Debug helpers: axes, grid, polarGrid, box3, arrow, camera and light helpers.
geometry: Custom and dynamic geometry: define, custom, dynamic, edges, wireframe, convex, merge.
texture: Texture builders: data, canvas, video, compressed, depth, cube, dataArray, load.
tsl: Subset of TSL node expressions for node materials (position, normal, time, uv, uniform, texture).
points: Point-cloud node with size attenuation and optional sprite map.
prefabs: Ready-made scene pieces: particleFountain, cityBlock, productStage, productViewer, solarSystem, dataBars3D, neonTunnel, physicsRamp and more.
sceneKits: Prompt-to-scene kits: physicsPlayground, particleFountain, solarSystem, neonTunnel, dataViz, miniGolf, materialLab, cityBlock, humanoidWalk, productViewer.
promptPlanToScene: Turn a prompt plan into a scene builder.
compilePromptPlanV2: Compile a prompt plan with the V2 compiler.
defineAuraAssets: Declare typed asset definitions; refs are used by `model(assets.x)`.
defineModelAssets: Declare a game's generated or bundled GLBs once, with same-origin URL and sha256 (see docs/api/model-loader.md).
AnimationController: Drive rigged characters from clip, skeleton and morph metadata; play and crossfade by clip name.
cloneSkinned: Clone a skinned model N times with independent skeletons (async).
attachRootRenderSource: Attach a render-source bridge (skinned and typed GLB actors) to the app canvas; returns a detach function.
particles: Particle effects: `particles.fountain` and particle material modes.
physics: Physics worlds, bodies and colliders (`world`, `worldFromScene`, `body`, `collider`, shapes).
raycast: Cast a world ray, or an NDC point through a camera, against scene query targets.
createFrameLoop: Create a frame loop with callbacks and snapshots.
createFixedStepLoop: Fixed-step simulation loop: variable frame time in, fixed steps out, with catch-up clamp and a manual mode for tests.
installQaHooks: Install the `window.__AURA_<NAME>__` hooks (`ready`, `state`, `stepFrames`, `reset`, `replay`, ...) that browser specs and capture tools read.
readQaParams: Parse the QA query parameters games repeat: `manual`, `autostart`, `warmup`, `seed`, `quality`.
createCountedRng: Seeded replay-stable random stream with a `draws` counter and `reset(seed)`.
game: Game runtime pieces: rules, loop, frame loop, input, input replay export and import.
createGameApp: Create an app with a game runtime attached.
createGame: Headless root stub: logs `CREATE_GAME_STUB` once; `touch` is `null`, `sound` is `undefined`, HUD and menus do nothing. Import the real kit from `@aura3d/engine/game` (docs/api/game-kit.md).
bindGameTouchControls: Bind on-screen controls to synthetic keyboard events.
racketSports: Racket sports kit: create, scoring, athlete rig, ball flight, ball physics.
fitSizeToRegion: Size an asset to occupy a chosen fraction of a region.
distributeInRegion: Distribute items evenly across a region with minimum spacing.
checkSpatialInvariants: Verify that helper geometry is anchored to its subject.
renderer: Renderer presets and diagnostics: exposure, color management, quality presets and profiles.
createAuraRouteHealthSnapshot: Snapshot route health for a running app.
